topology: 2 nodes x4 H100, NVSHMEM put-ring over 8 PEs, both providers

expect_fail.reason: multinode NVSHMEM under NVBit hangs before the workload reports. Isolated 2026-07-27: NOT a coexistence problem — 2 nodes with gpumem ALONE also deadlocks (isoB, exit 124), while 1 node with BOTH providers completes cleanly (isoA, exit 0). NVBit's own NO_EAGER_LOAD=0 hint does not help (isoC, exit 124). Same family as 05: a comm library spinning on the device vs NVBit's bounded channel.
expect_fail.fix_ideas: spillable/host-pinned channel; cooperative flush that preempts the spinning kernel; or IBGDA transport so the device posts WQEs without a host proxy to wait on

golden: n/a — kept red on purpose. checks/*.sql document the intended cross-transport oracle for when it is fixed.
why: the unified NVLink+IB TRAFFIC timeline: the ring's 6 intra-node hops go over NVLink and its 2 inter-node hops over IB, in one execution. This is the capture that makes cross-transport causality recoverable — replay cannot express it, since its passes are different executions.
